mechanism_narrative: The RETAIL_REC series shows three consecutive weeks of deep negative values with a further decline from -85.0 to -87.1, indicating persistent demand destruction that will continue to depress retail footfall over the next four weeks absent any external shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -85.0 to -87.1 over the last two weeks
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the mean over the last 28 days, the momentum-persistence mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained suppression of TRANSIT below -80 for three consecutive weeks signals continued enforcement of movement restrictions, which mechanically limits the trips needed to reach retail and recreation venues, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -80 for three consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT recorded -86.0, -86.0, -84.9 over the last three weeks
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises above -70 while RETAIL_REC simultaneously improves, the transit-restriction suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RESIDENTIAL (19.7 to 33.0) combined with flat, deeply negative WORKPLACES (-80.7 to -80.6) jointly indicate entrenched stay-at-home behavior; when both signals move together in this direction, discretionary retail visits are suppressed for the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL increases week-on-week while WORKPLACES remains flat or declines
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 19.7 to 33.0 while WORKPLACES stayed near -80
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining elevated and WORKPLACES remaining flat or falling, the interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM's modest rebound from -75.7 to -70.0 reflects selective policy easing that prioritizes essential retail over recreational retail; this regime pattern implies RETAIL_REC will remain disproportionately suppressed relative to GROCERY_PHARM over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -75.7 to -70.0 while RETAIL_REC worsened from -85.1 to -87.1
regime_hint: selective reopening regime prioritizing essential goods
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM converge or RETAIL_REC improves faster than GROCERY_PHARM over the next four weeks, the selective-easing mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility collapsed from -48.4 to roughly -76 and has since plateaued, consistent with a seasonal pattern (heat or monsoon onset) that discourages outdoor activity; this reduced outdoor orientation correlates with reduced incidental retail stops, pulling RETAIL_REC down over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -48.4 to -77.4 then stabilized near -76
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next week while PARKS remains flat or falls further, the seasonal-outdoor-linkage mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has remained below -85 for three consecutive weeks (t-2w, t-1w, t-0w), a threshold indicating sustained closure or capacity restriction of retail venues; crossing and holding this threshold triggers further contraction in footfall over the following two weeks as businesses reduce operating hours or shut down.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC remains below -85 for three consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC values were -85.1, -85.0, -87.1 over the last three weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC recovers above -80 within the next four weeks despite having met the below-85 threshold condition, the threshold-contraction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES have jointly remained at deeply suppressed levels (around -85 and -80 respectively) for multiple weeks; this combination removes both the commuting trips and incidental errands that normally feed retail footfall, reinforcing suppressed RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -75 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both stayed near -80 to -86 across the last three weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC improves over the next four weeks while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -75, the joint-suppression interaction mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-easing regime, GROCERY_PHARM's sustained rebound (from -75.7 to -70.0) signals growing consumer willingness to leave home for errands; this behavioral confidence is expected to spill over into recreational retail, producing a modest rise in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved for two consecutive weeks from -75.7 to -70.0
regime_hint: early easing regime with cautious consumer return
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC continues to decline over the next week despite GROCERY_PHARM sustaining its rebound for two or more weeks, the behavioral-spillover mechanism is rejected.
